_comment: Phase 13 speech inventory. `npm run voice:record` fills audio/manifest.json;
any line not yet recorded plays through live TTS.
Lesson audioPrompt values are collected from lessons.json automatically and are
deliberately not repeated here — one line, one home.
No `groups` and no number words: praise, correction and the numbers all come
from the common pack. Common holds what every skill says the same way, so
re-recording them here would ship a second copy of a clip the app already has
and override it with an identical one.
